requirement: Return one antibiotic as a read-only projection: its identity, group (with the parent name resolved through the navigation), classification, and dosages with their CrCl ranges; a missing ID is reported as ResourceNotFound.

preconditions.text: The requested antibiotic exists with a group, a parent chain, and its dosages
The requested antibiotic sits directly in a root group
The requested ID matches no live antibiotic

inputs.text: Query for Amoxicillin in the Penicillins subgroup with a standard and a renal-adjusted dose
Query for Azithromycin in the root group Macrolides with one standard dose
Query with an unknown antibiotic ID

returns.text: Success with the identity, name, and classification of the antibiotic
The group projection carries the group fields and the parent name from the navigation
A root group reports a null parent ID and a null parent name
Dosages are projected with their route, dose text, and CrCl range
Failure with ResourceNotFound and the 'Antibiotic not found' error

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing antibiotic is returned as a failed Result
